about: What Kyle's Polish tab charges for tooling and consumables when it works the figure out itself, recorded from the template by backend/tests/js/polish-tooling-oracle.js (hyperformula 2.7.1, the engine the page ships). `in` is what was typed: sf (E18), lf (E19), dye (E25), reno (B10), system (F36: cream, S&P or full) and traditional (G36). `out` is C51 (the rate per SF), B51 (the area), D51 (tooling and consumables), B52 and D52 (demo tooling, a quantity nobody types here), B53 and D53 (slurry hardener), B54 and D54 (plastic) and D55 (the total).
